title: Device perf measurement
description: Per-platform output of run_android_perf.sh / run_ios_perf.sh. Mirrors Flashlight's shape on Android; iOS fields are a subset (cold start + memory; frame data is gated on Xcrun availability).

device_profile.description: Free-form identifier for the emulator / simulator profile used (e.g. `pixel_5_api_33_2gb`, `iphone_se_3rd_gen`).

score.description: Tool-reported overall score (Flashlight). Null when the tool did not emit one.

startup_time_ms.description: Cold-start to first-interactive frame, in milliseconds.

additionalProperties.description: Mean CPU percentage for the named thread over the iteration.

growth.description: Memory delta from iteration start to iteration end (positive = leak suspect).

blocking_intervals_ms.description: Durations of main-thread blocking intervals > 50 ms (Android only). Each entry's units are milliseconds.

intervals.description: Per-step measurements tied back to the Maestro flow step labels.

raw_artifact_path.description: Workspace-relative path to the underlying tool output (Flashlight JSON, xcrun log). Kept for diagnostics; never read by the report renderer.

tool_warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings the measurement tool emitted (e.g. missing trace point, fallback profile used).
